content.stem: 以下哪一项描述了金融行动特别工作组(FATF)的作用？

options.A: 对金融行动特别工作组成员国金融情报机构的监督
options.B: 提供一个独特的平台,用于交流有关反洗钱工作的信息
options.C: 通过指令和行政命令对金融市场进行监管
options.D: 加强国际合作,通过建议和指导促进反洗钱工作

content.stem_en: Which of the following describes a role of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)?

options_en.A: Oversight of the Financial Intelligence Units in FATF member countries
options_en.B: Providing a unique platform for information exchange regarding anti-money laundering efforts
options_en.C: Regulation of financial markets through directives and executive orders
options_en.D: Enhancement of international cooperation to foster anti-money laundering efforts via recommendations and guidance
